alerts.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 2 at 3:14AM EDT until October 4 at 4:00AM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...Walton and Bay County Beaches.

* WHEN...Through late Saturday night.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.
